description:
Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Fleet Logisitics Center (FLC) Norfolk Contracting Department, Norfolk VA, 23511-3392, intends to award a firm fixed price contract in support of the Maritime Expeditionary Security Sqaudron (MSRON) 4. This acquisition will be conducted using the policies and procedures of FAR PART 12, Acqusition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. Please see attachments for further information. The associated Naics Code is 562991 with a small business size standard of $9,000,000.00.

This requirement is to provide the services of eighteen (18) PORT-A-Johns, Eight (8) handwashing stations and three (3) heated shower trailers in accordance with the performance work statement.

Place of performance: 1201 Jamestown Rd, Williamsburg, VA 23185 (See pictures and drawings attached)

SPECIAL NOTICE: This was posted to the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) on March 18th 2026, however due to system errors it did not route to SAM.
